title: A tidier quest log and Skills tab
changes: The quest log has Active, Completed and Rumours tabs. Quests are grouped by story with how far along you are, and long titles show in full when you hover them.
Each quest shows who gave it, where, its level, every objective with its count in a bar, and its rewards.
Click the diamond beside a quest to track it on screen and on the map, and press Show on map to open the world map on its objective.
A skill's details now show only in its hover card, so the Skills tab fits on smaller screens without scrolling.
